FN-KYG9UA-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 153
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/18/2023
Senate Bill 153 as introduced provides that a judge may order a defendant charged with a Class
A or Class B violent felony offense to be supervised by the Board of Pardons and Paroles, as a
condition of bond. This could increase the obligations of the Board, by an undetermined
amount, dependent upon the number of defendants charged with Class A or Class B violent
felony offenses that would require supervision and the type of supervision utilized to comply
with the provisions of this bill. According to the Administrative Office of Courts, the number of
Class A and Class B violent felony offenses filed in fiscal years 2021 and 2022 were 24,576 and
24,324, respectively.
Page 1

FN-KYG9UA-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 153
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/28/2023
Senate Bill 153 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Board of Pardons and
Paroles by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of defendants charged with
Class A or Class B violent felony offenses and ordered to be supervised and the type of
supervision utilized to comply with the provisions of this bill. According to the Administrative
Office of Courts, the number of Class A and Class B violent felony offenses filed in fiscal years
2021 and 2022 were 24,576 and 24,324, respectively.
